mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% triggers a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 8.5% in the specified period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of ultra-low federal funds rates and robust demand growth (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS-GDPC1 combination does not occur as predicted, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high CPIAUCSL inflation coupled with ultra-low FEDFUNDS rates creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL-FEDFUNDS combination does not occur in the late-cycle regime, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high supply (INDPRO) and demand (HOUST) indicators signal a robust economic environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO-HOUST combination does not occur, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in job openings (PAYEMS) above historical norms signals a strong labor market, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 130,738 in the specified period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS rate does not rise above 4% in the tightening regime, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 8.5% signals a weakening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE rate does not fall below 8.5% in the specified period, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
